name: cc-immerse
description: Learn a language while you work in Claude Code: replies stay in the language you are learning with your own one click away, what you type in your own language is sent in that language, and what you type in it is corrected beside the conversation.

nativeLanguage.title: Immerse · Your language
nativeLanguage.description: The language you already read and write. Translations and correction notes are written in it, and what you type in it is sent in the language you are learning.

targetLanguage.title: Immerse · Language you are learning
targetLanguage.description: The language you work in. Replies in it get a translation on request, and what you type in it is corrected.

readingLevel.title: Immerse · Reading
readingLevel.description: Off: replies are left as they are. 1: your language, with the language you are learning behind a click. 2: both, your language first. 3: both, the language you are learning first. 4: the language you are learning, with your language behind a click. /immerse shows each of them.

layout.title: Immerse · Layout at levels 2 and 3
layout.description: Side by side: the two languages in two columns, in a wide window. Below: the second language under each block.

mark.title: Immerse · Mark
mark.description: The character you click to open a block’s translation.

markPosition.title: Immerse · Mark position
markPosition.description: Beside which line of its block the mark sits.

markVisibility.title: Immerse · Mark visibility
markVisibility.description: On hover: the mark appears while the pointer is on its block. Always: it is drawn at rest.

translationStyle.title: Immerse · Translation style
translationStyle.description: How an open translation is drawn.

allButtons.title: Immerse · Open-all and close-all buttons
allButtons.description: Two buttons at the end of a message that open or close every translation in it.

nativeInput.title: Immerse · What you type in your language
nativeInput.description: Send in the language you are learning: Claude receives that version. Show it, send as typed: you see that version, Claude receives your own words. Leave it alone: nothing is done.
nativeInput.default: Send in the language you are learning
options: Send in the language you are learning

livePreview.title: Immerse · Preview while typing
livePreview.description: A line above the prompt box, made each time you pause: your draft in the language you are learning, or as it would read corrected. One small model call per pause.

previewDelay.title: Immerse · Preview wait
previewDelay.description: How long you must pause before the preview is made. Longer means fewer model calls.

corrections.title: Immerse · Corrections
corrections.description: When what you type in the language you are learning is corrected.
